table-difference-quotient.alt: Five measured temperatures B(t) of a cooling loaf of bread, in degrees Fahrenheit, at t = 0, 4, 10, 14 and 20 minutes: 180, 152, 121, 105 and 88. A dashed secant line joins the points at t = 10 and t = 14, on either side of t = 12. Its slope, (105 minus 121) over (14 minus 10), is minus 4 degrees Fahrenheit per minute, the estimate of B prime of 12.
